note: State is scoped. automated_verified means the deterministic checks passed; it is not educator review, learner testing or production approval. A row may be draft while the lesson contract is automated_verified: coverage and review are different questions.

capabilities.claim: 70 authored lessons meet the deterministic contract; 70 are machine_checked.
capabilities.nextAction: Keep the contract gate in every content batch.

capabilities.scope: All 135 concepts required by the current bank
capabilities.claim: 70 authored / 135; 65 outlines remain; no critical stage-1 gap remains.
capabilities.nextAction: Author the next high-priority outline from reports/lesson-quality/queue.md; no critical stage-1 gap remains.

capabilities.scope: Every authored lesson, against its exact version and content hash
capabilities.claim: 0 educator-reviewed; 70 authored lessons await a qualified human review.
knownDefects: No genuine educator approval exists; fixture records are not human evidence.
capabilities.nextAction: A qualified subject teacher reviews the exact versions and records the decision through the authenticated route.

capabilities.scope: Independent transfer and delayed retention on real learners
capabilities.claim: 0 learner-tested lessons. The pilot protocol exists; no learner trial has been conducted.
knownDefects: No supervised learner evidence, no transfer result, no delayed-retention result.
capabilities.nextAction: Run the stated pilot protocol with real, supervised learners; do not infer learning from browser completion.

capabilities.scope: Authenticated educator review, from the browser form through persistence and restart
capabilities.claim: The refactored API-client form passed the browser submit phase (38/0) and the after-restart persistence phase (18/0) against a scratch store.
capabilities.nextAction: Keep this path in the regression set; it is a fixture, not human review evidence.

capabilities.claim: 71 national pathways across 70 countries; 0 reviewed mappings; 18 pathways have no structural source on file.
knownDefects: No pathway has a human-reviewed concept mapping.
18 pathways have no source URL on file.
capabilities.nextAction: Choose one exact launch profile and verify its specification version, objectives, assessment and concept mapping before declaring support.

capabilities.claim: 15 interface languages are checked by the full engine suite.
capabilities.nextAction: Keep new UI strings authored in every dictionary; this is not a teaching-language claim.

capabilities.scope: Lesson prose, worked examples, questions, feedback and diagrams per language
capabilities.claim: 0 human-reviewed teaching languages; 2 machine-translated and explicitly unreviewed.
knownDefects: No native-speaking teacher has reviewed a translated lesson.
capabilities.nextAction: Translate one reviewed lesson into one launch language, then have a native-speaking teacher review it.

capabilities.scope: Authoring → rendering → input → validation → server marking → feedback → evidence → next step
capabilities.claim: Multiple-choice, numeric, expression and several structured formats exist and are covered by the engine suite; a per-launch-profile format matrix has not been agreed.
knownDefects: The required format set is not yet derived from a declared launch curriculum.
capabilities.nextAction: Declare the required response formats for the first launch profile, then verify each through the full marking path.

capabilities.scope: Teacher sign-in, classes, assignments, learner work and teacher review across sessions and devices
capabilities.claim: The classroom routes and browser harnesses exist; this checkpoint has not executed a fresh two-device session.
knownDefects: Fresh browser evidence is outstanding at this checkpoint.
capabilities.nextAction: Run the two-device and assignment browser walks against a scratch store.

capabilities.scope: Structural WCAG checks, keyboard paths, reflow and rendered maths
capabilities.claim: A structural audit previously passed 96 assertions; it predates the physics-energy lesson and the review-form transport change.
knownDefects: Re-run required after the new lesson.
A structural scan is not a screen-reader session or a conformance claim.
capabilities.nextAction: Re-run the accessibility audit and manually test with a screen reader.

capabilities.scope: Production build, startup, assets and durable-store behaviour
capabilities.claim: The fail-closed durable-store design and deployment documentation exist; this checkpoint has not rebuilt or restarted the production server after the latest content change.
knownDefects: Production-check has not been run at this checkpoint.
The target deployment's durable storage is not declared or verified.
capabilities.nextAction: Build, start with a declared durable store, and verify a learner write survives a restart.

capabilities.scope: Actual screen-reader, switch, low-vision and motor access
capabilities.claim: No assistive-technology session has been performed.
knownDefects: Screen-reader announcement of mathematical notation is unmeasured.
capabilities.nextAction: Run the recorded manual protocol with a real assistive-technology user.

capabilities.scope: Privacy, safeguarding and legal requirements per deployment jurisdiction
capabilities.claim: The code has security and privacy controls, but no qualified jurisdiction-specific legal review is recorded.
knownDefects: No legal compliance claim is made.
capabilities.nextAction: Document the deployment jurisdiction and obtain qualified review before claiming compliance.

backlog.nextAction: Keep the route in the browser regression set; the signed-in account is a fixture, not learner evidence.

backlog.title: Author and browser-verify the motion-graphs lesson
backlog.why: This closed one of the two critical stage-1 physics gaps; the full contract, a server-marked numeric answer and 320-px reflow passed 10/0 in the browser.
backlog.nextAction: Keep the route in the browser regression set and retain the lesson's draft review status.

backlog.title: Author and browser-verify the waves-basics lesson
backlog.why: This closed the last critical stage-1 physics gap; the full contract, a server-marked numeric answer and 320-px reflow passed 10/0 in the browser.
backlog.nextAction: Keep the route in the browser regression set and retain the lesson's draft review status.

backlog.title: Author the next high-priority lesson outline
backlog.why: There are no critical stage-1 gaps left, but 65 high-priority outlines remain; the queue is now the content backlog.
backlog.nextAction: Take the first item in reports/lesson-quality/queue.md and author it to openmind.lesson/1.0, then regenerate and run the lesson gates.

backlog.title: Declare one exact international launch profile
backlog.why: The registry has 71 national pathways and 0 reviewed mappings; no country + curriculum + qualification + version + subject + level + language combination is honestly release-ready.
backlog.nextAction: Pick one profile, cite its official specification, map its objectives to concepts, and record what is covered and what is not.

backlog.title: Create the first reviewed teaching translation
backlog.why: 15 interface languages are not a multilingual teaching claim; 0 teaching languages are reviewed and 2 are machine-only.
backlog.nextAction: Translate one lesson and have a native-speaking subject teacher review the exact version.

backlog.title: Run the assistive-technology protocol
backlog.why: Automated structure checks cannot establish screen-reader, switch or motor access.
backlog.nextAction: Use a real screen reader and a real assistive-technology user; record what failed.

backlog.title: Re-run the production build and restart drill
backlog.why: New content and an API-client change must not be assumed safe for production because the engine suite is green.
backlog.nextAction: Run the production build, asset verification, and a durable-store restart with a scratch target.

backlog.title: Obtain genuine educator reviews
backlog.why: 0 of 70 authored lessons has a human subject review.
backlog.nextAction: Send the version-pinned pack to a qualified teacher and record the real decision.

backlog.title: Run the supervised learner pilot
backlog.why: No learner transfer or delayed-retention evidence exists.
backlog.nextAction: Run the stated protocol with consent and safeguarding; do not claim effectiveness from completion.

externalBlockers.why: A person, not a script, must judge subject accuracy, curriculum accuracy, teaching quality and assessment validity.
externalBlockers.ready: Version- and hash-pinned review packs, an authenticated intake route, persistence and an improvement queue.
externalBlockers.exactHumanStep: A teacher reads the pack for one exact version and records an approve or changes-requested decision through /lesson-review/<concept>.

externalBlockers.why: Independent transfer and delayed retention cannot be established from completion, satisfaction or a synthetic browser learner.
externalBlockers.ready: A learner pilot protocol with baseline, post-assessment, unfamiliar transfer, delayed retrieval and reporting limits.
externalBlockers.exactHumanStep: Run the protocol under consent and safeguarding, then record the actual results without promotion by completion.

externalBlockers.why: Machine translation is not native-speaker or educator approval.
externalBlockers.ready: Two machine-translated lessons, explicitly labelled unreviewed; 15 interface dictionaries.
externalBlockers.exactHumanStep: Review one translated lesson against the English source and record language, scope and findings.

externalBlockers.why: A structural scan cannot establish screen-reader announcement, switch access or motor usability.
externalBlockers.ready: A recorded manual protocol and automated structural checks.
externalBlockers.exactHumanStep: Run a real screen-reader and keyboard session, then record the failures.

externalBlockers.why: Privacy, safeguarding and legal compliance depend on the deployment jurisdiction and cannot be inferred from code.
externalBlockers.ready: Security, data-minimisation and deletion controls, plus a documented deployment posture.
externalBlockers.exactHumanStep: Name the target jurisdiction, obtain qualified review, and record its scope and findings.
